how_it_becomes_solid: cooling and solidification (metals, wax, glass); chemical curing (resins)
conventional_primary_shaping: sand casting; die casting; investment casting; continuous casting; resin casting
then_forming: rolling and forging of cast ingots
then_cutting: removal of risers, machining of functional faces
am_counterparts: vat photopolymerisation (SLA, DLP, continuous, two-photon); material jetting (photopolymer, wax). PBF and DED pass through a transient melt pool but start from a solid
typical_materials: Al and cast iron; steels; Ni superalloys; epoxy and acrylate resins; wax; glass

how_it_becomes_solid: viscous flow, then cooling (thermoplastics) or vulcanisation (rubber)
conventional_primary_shaping: injection moulding; extrusion; blow moulding; thixomoulding of semi-solid metal
am_counterparts: material extrusion: filament (FFF), pellets, large-area extrusion
typical_materials: PLA, ABS, PA, PEEK; semi-solid Mg and Al

how_it_becomes_solid: drying, hydration (cement), gelation, then firing for ceramics
conventional_primary_shaping: slip casting; clay and brick extrusion; concrete casting; tape casting
am_counterparts: paste material extrusion (robocasting / direct ink writing, clay printing, concrete printing); vat photopolymerisation of ceramic-loaded slurries
typical_materials: clay; alumina and zirconia slurries; cement and concrete; food pastes
everyday_analogue: piping icing; cake batter baked in a tin

how_it_becomes_solid: solid-state sintering (diffusion); binder; partial or full melting
conventional_primary_shaping: pressing and sintering (powder metallurgy); metal injection moulding; hot isostatic pressing; sand-mould making
am_counterparts: powder bed fusion (laser, electron beam, polymer SLS); binder jetting + sintering; powder DED; cold spray
typical_materials: Ti-6Al-4V, 316L, IN718 powders; PA12; foundry sand; ceramics

how_it_becomes_solid: binder curing under pressure; fibre entanglement and hydrogen bonding (paper)
conventional_primary_shaping: particle board and MDF pressing; papermaking; felting
am_counterparts: sheet lamination (paper LOM); continuous-fibre material extrusion; automated fibre placement
typical_materials: wood chips and fibres with resin; cellulose; carbon and glass fibres

how_it_becomes_solid: condensation (PVD) or chemical reaction on a hot surface (CVD)
conventional_primary_shaping: CVD and PVD; free-standing CVD parts (SiC, diamond, Ni-carbonyl shells)
am_counterparts: laser CVD (LCVD); electron- and ion-beam induced deposition; aerosol jet (droplets carried by gas)
everyday_analogue: frost on a window; soot on a candle glass

how_it_becomes_solid: electrochemical reduction of metal ions on a cathode
conventional_primary_shaping: electroforming: Ni mould shells, thin foils, waveguides, micro-parts
am_counterparts: electrochemical AM: localised electrodeposition through a micro-nozzle or meniscus, multi-anode arrays
